title: Chat: native per-session model picker and opt-in timed cloud fallback (#1332)
body:
Closes #1332

## Scope
- Native Windows launcher only: persistent per-chat Automatic/local-profile/configured-cloud selection, inherited by chat forks.
- Opt-in chat fallback with 30-second, 60-second, or No timeout settings. No timeout is the initial choice; fallback is disabled by default.
- Confirmation grants chat-fallback permission only. Global remote AI permission and existing self-work escalation remain unchanged; local-only blocks cloud choices and fallback.
- Handoff is allowed only before reply text or tool actions begin. Abort propagates through startup, HTTP completion, streaming, and best-of-N requests.
- Cancelled sole-owned model processes are tree-killed and exit-awaited before cloud handoff. Shared/external servers are not killed. Failed cleanup prevents fallback; cancellation does not roll back a model build.
- Answering-model/fallback labels survive history and reply-version changes. Cloud requests have bounded wall time and response size; endpoint paths normalize `/v1` once.
- API keys retain existing protected storage and are not exposed by status/picker endpoints. Blank preserves the saved key; Clear key removes it on Save.

## Verification
- Clean review 1 after the final consent/recovery change: behavior/source audit; 328 focused Node tests passed.
- Clean review 2 after the final consent/recovery change: permissions/security/persistence audit; 230 Node tests passed.
- Native suite: 1,470 passed, 28 fixture-dependent skips.
- Desktop suite: 78 passed. Plugin suite: 445 passed.
- Clean review 3: final source/contract audit is clean and the native, desktop, and plugin regression suites passed on `9aff8e7f55fb45cd5019fca1e639b2b75b125c59`. All current-head CI checks passed, including full Node, native Windows build/tests, .NET build, Desktop, DCO, and every CodeQL analysis. The local full regression run completed all 223 files; the final consent guards were additionally covered by focused tests after that run had started. Review count was reset on every source change, and no source changes followed the final three clean reviews.
- Verified that the local Node runner and its test children exited, with no matching test processes remaining.
- Native UI coverage uses offscreen WinForms layout tests; no paid cloud requests or live GPU inference smoke test was performed.

## Owner-Selected Local Recovery
Existing cloud-selected chats automatically use the active local profile when that endpoint is no longer configured/permitted or local-only mode is enabled. The picker displays the effective local choice. Recovery cannot bounce back into another cloud endpoint, while new cloud selections still require permission. The saved preference is retained rather than silently overwritten. Do not merge until three clean reviews and current-head CI are complete.

The final audit also fixed permission revocation during a pending reply: current fallback settings are re-read before handoff, and selecting the fallback endpoint as primary rechecks scoped consent before sending. A changed primary endpoint/model falls back locally for that turn rather than sending to a different model with a stale label.
